MARKET OVERVIEW

1. What is the Current Market Regime?
NEUTRAL per the supplied regime, with normal volatility at 26.6% and narrow breadth: only 1/8 sectors positive. The breadth signal is weak despite volatility remaining in the normal range.

2. Which sectors are leading?
Technology & Telecom leads, up 1.26% on the week but down 11.93% on the month, a RECOVERY. Its strongest names include KONTR (1W: +12.08% | 1M: -18.14%) RECOVERY and TCELL (1W: -4.05% | 1M: -7.23%) BELOW TREND.

3. Which sectors are lagging?
Energy & Chemicals is weakest at -9.71% for the week and -17.34% for the month, BELOW TREND; Transportation is next weakest at -7.36% and -10.85%, BELOW TREND. Heavy Industry is also BELOW TREND, down 6.20% on the week and 14.65% on the month.

STOCK PERFORMANCE

4. Top Performing Stocks?
KONTR (1W: +12.08% | 1M: -18.14%) RECOVERY and TKFEN (1W: +9.85% | 1M: -19.01%) RECOVERY lead the week. ASELS (1W: +3.69% | 1M: +5.91%) ABOVE TREND, FROTO (1W: +3.52% | 1M: -6.99%) RECOVERY, and ENKAI (1W: +3.50% | 1M: -7.43%) RECOVERY round out the top five.

5. Worst Performing Stocks?
VESTL (1W: -21.68% | 1M: -36.95%) BELOW TREND and GUBRF (1W: -21.58% | 1M: -32.59%) BELOW TREND were the weakest. HEKTS (1W: -16.40% | 1M: -24.04%), EREGL (1W: -14.51% | 1M: -15.07%), and TRMET (1W: -11.06% | 1M: -19.92%) are also BELOW TREND.

6. Momentum Stocks?
The strongest weekly moves came from KONTR (1W: +12.08% | 1M: -18.14%) RECOVERY, TKFEN (1W: +9.85% | 1M: -19.01%) RECOVERY, and ASELS (1W: +3.69% | 1M: +5.91%) ABOVE TREND. FROTO (1W: +3.52% | 1M: -6.99%) and ENKAI (1W: +3.50% | 1M: -7.43%) are RECOVERY names, but their monthly returns remain negative.

SECTOR OUTLOOK

7. Banking Sector Outlook?
Banking & Finance is BELOW TREND, down 4.80% on the week and 6.66% on the month. AKBNK (1W: -6.25% | 1M: -9.87%), GARAN (1W: -4.45% | 1M: -1.86%), and ISCTR (1W: -5.83% | 1M: -6.41%) are all BELOW TREND.

8. Industrial Sector Outlook?
Heavy Industry is BELOW TREND, down 6.20% for the week and 14.65% for the month, though performance is mixed within the group. ASELS (1W: +3.69% | 1M: +5.91%) is ABOVE TREND and FROTO (1W: +3.52% | 1M: -6.99%) is in RECOVERY, while EREGL (1W: -14.51% | 1M: -15.07%) is BELOW TREND.

9. Energy & Chemicals Outlook?
Energy & Chemicals is the weakest sector, down 9.71% on the week and 17.34% on the month, BELOW TREND. TUPRS (1W: -1.18% | 1M: -5.71%), SASA (1W: -10.24% | 1M: -20.74%), and GUBRF (1W: -21.58% | 1M: -32.59%) are all BELOW TREND.

PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

10. Portfolio Recommendation?
Stay defensive and selective: narrow breadth and negative returns across seven sectors argue against broad risk-taking. Favor relative strength in ASELS (1W: +3.69% | 1M: +5.91%) ABOVE TREND, while treating weekly rebounds in RECOVERY names as unconfirmed until monthly momentum improves.

NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?
Monitor ASELS (1W: +3.69% | 1M: +5.91%) ABOVE TREND for continuation, and KONTR (1W: +12.08% | 1M: -18.14%) RECOVERY and TKFEN (1W: +9.85% | 1M: -19.01%) RECOVERY for follow-through. FROTO (1W: +3.52% | 1M: -6.99%) RECOVERY offers another rebound candidate, but remains below its monthly trend.

12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?
Technology & Telecom is the only positive sector on the week, but remains in RECOVERY given its negative monthly return. Watch Energy & Chemicals and Transportation for stabilization after their sharp weekly declines; both remain BELOW TREND.

13. Key Levels & Triggers?
No XU100 price levels or specific catalysts were provided, so actionable index levels cannot be stated. Key signals to monitor are breadth improving from 1/8 positive sectors and volatility holding near its current 26.6%.

EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

The supplied regime is NEUTRAL, but 1/8 positive sectors signals narrow participation and keeps the market tone defensive. Relative strength is concentrated in a small set of names, while sharp losses in Energy & Chemicals and continued weakness across most sectors remain the principal risks.
